routes.name: Unconditional global construction and original main theorem

C9000185.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 185 (Counterexamples to infinite matroid intersection and packing/covering.; papers: A Counterexample to the Infinite Matroid Packing/Covering Conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/185.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_LOCAL_INTERVALS.statement: For every positive prototype with positive complement, both manuscript basis rules satisfy prop:local-intervals with the original quantifiers.

C_DEFINITION_BRIDGES.statement: The literal manuscript ground set, blocks, density ideal, class, probes and extended limits equal the concrete implementation definitions.

C_DENSITY_CONTINUITY.statement: The actual probes are uniformly cylinder-continuous on any interval in one density-zero class.

C_FINITE_ROUNDING.statement: Finite lower or upper limiting values can be rounded into (-1,0] using the available finite gap.

C_INFINITE_INTERPOLATION.statement: Opposite infinite lower limits admit interpolation, including the final correction when the limiting lower bound is -1.

C_SPARSE_POOLS.statement: A positive addition or deletion pool supplies a density-zero modification with probes diverging in the prescribed direction.

C_RULE_DUALITY.statement: Complementation identifies the lower and upper rules with the exact strict boundaries -1 and 1 and common closed boundary 0.

C_MAIN_COUNTEREXAMPLE.statement: Unconditionally, two matroids on one countably infinite labelled ground set are each equal to their dual and admit neither independent covering nor a mixed packing/covering partition.

C_ULTRAFILTER_RANK.statement: The concrete independent columns and density ideal yield the ultrafilter and rank-raising antitone ordinal rank without extra set-theoretic assumptions.

C_SIMULTANEOUS_RESERVATIONS.statement: Every fewer-than-continuum family of positive sets is met positively by both disjoint concrete K0-small cells.

C_MAXIMAL_EXTENSION.statement: The unconditional transfinite prototype assembly defines an actual matroid with maximal extension inside every subset and labelled self-duality.

C_LABELLED_OBSTRUCTION.statement: The original double-ray coordinates yield labelled self-duality, strictly descending ranks under any covering, and exclusion of every mixed packing/covering partition with the correct minors.

C_GLOBAL_ASSEMBLY.statement: The ultrafilter rank, simultaneous reservations and transfinite prototype assembly yield the asserted global basis family in ZFC.

C_ORDINAL_DESCENT.statement: The assembled matroid has all hypotheses needed for the advertised ordinal-descent counterexamples.
